episodes.title: Replay: Principles and Algorithms for Work and Life | Ray Dalio (2019)
episodes.description: Can you turn the lessons you learn from experience into a repeatable system for making better decisions? Ray Dalio argues that writing down the principles behind your decisions, testing them against history, and eventually turning them into algorithms can help. In this archive conversation, Ray joins a16z’s Alex Rampell and Sonal Chokshi to discuss decision-making under uncertainty, learning from mistakes, and why understanding cause and effect matters more than blindly trusting a black-box model. They also get into radical open-mindedness, judging people on process rather than outcomes, building teams around complementary strengths, and why knowing what you don’t know may be more valuable than what you do. Resources: Follow Ray Dalio on X: https://x.com/RayDalio X Blog Follow Alex Rampell

episodes.description: 新制度「企業価値担保権」を活用し、設立2年目のスタートアップであるマイクロニティが静岡銀行から5億円の融資を受け、オンライン試験基盤を手掛けるIBT総研を買収した事例を解説します。不動産担保や経営者保証に依存せず、買収先の将来キャッシュフローや事業そのものを担保とする新たな融資手法の全貌とは。従来のLBOで課題だった担保の重層化をどう解消したのか、銀行は何を評価してリスクを取ったのかを紐解きます。審査と並行して重視された融資後の綿密なモニタリング体制や、全国で50件超へと広がる制度活用の現場から、スタートアップM&Aと事業承継ファイナンスの現在地をお届けします。

episodes.title: Why China Is Playing the Long Game on Self-Reliance in AI Chips | Jianggan Li - E751
episodes.description: Jianggan Li joins Jeremy Au after the Trump and Xi meeting around the APEC summit in Shenzhen on 18-19 November 2026. Jianggan argues that leaders talking is better than silence, and he points to the UN Security Council veto as a way of keeping major powers in the system. They then turn to Nvidia and China. Jianggan cites a leaked DeepSeek investor call in which four Huawei chips equal one Nvidia chip, with the gap widening at hundreds of chips. He explains why Beijing prefers self-reliance, contrasting Nvidia's imported chips with Tesla's Shanghai supply chain. The conversation turns to the 600,000 H200 chips stuck in Hong Kong, and the Jensen Huang and Dwarkesh Patel debate over selling chips to China. episodes.description: ▎節目專訪 皓準科技 創辦人暨執行長 王議弘 Kerrif 騎腳踏車的時候，總有一隻腳特別累？那不一定是你體力差，而是每個人都有慣用腳。皓準科技依每位騎士的踩踏數據，設計出專屬的非圓形鏈盤，再由自己的產線生產，去年營收達 200 萬美元。 本集邀請創辦人 Kerrif，聊聊他從鴻海回到家族企業、再到自己創業的轉折：被奧運金牌導師勸退、一家一家拜訪美國自行車店，為了自己生產抵押房子，一路堅持打造台灣品牌。 ▎本集重點 📌05:08 騎平路，為什麼像在騎下坡？ 📌15:49 奧運金牌導師，為什麼勸他別創業？ 📌37:32 第一片鏈盤，為什麼等了六個月？ 📌42:09 在鴻海做到副總特助，為什麼一通電話就回家？ 📌46:52 抵押了房子，他的停損點在哪裡？ 📌1:05:51 回到創業第一天，他最想提醒自己什麼？ 【創投公會】創創燒IG： https://tvca01.pse.is/74hq7d 【創投公會】創創燒LINE： https://lin.ee/51qEzAk 【創投公會】粉專： https://www.facebook.com/tvca.org.tw 【創投公會】YouTube： https://www.youtube.com/@tvca6632 【皓準科技】官網： https://zh-tw.haojuen.com/ 本節目由"Koucast"團隊後製剪輯 版權音樂：Bright Song by Konstantin Garbuzyuk 本集節目由創投公會製作，益鼎創投與 ITIC 贊助播出。 Powered by Firstory Hosting
